path.description: Where components are copied, e.g. src/app/ui.

theme.description: The theme: slate, glass, bento, midnight, clay, mono, tint (graphite: the 1.5 name of slate), nova, luma, mira, sera.

fontHeading.description: Heading font. Left out: same as font.

accent.description: Accent color over the base color. Left out: none.

chartColor.description: Chart colors: base, an accent, or left out to follow the accent.

preset.description: The whole look as an ivp1_ code, written when a dial is off its default. `ivorie apply <theme>` keeps its dials. Left out: every dial at its default.

registry.description: Registry dir or URL. Default: the bundled one.
